messages:
deploybot: Starting canary deploy to production for v1.14.0 (tag: release/v1.14.0) - buildkite build #4721 - commit 9f3a2b1
sara: saw the deploybot. monitoring smoke checks :eyes:
ci-bot: build #4721 triggered: running lint -> unit tests -> integration tests
ci-bot: build #4721: lint passed (0 warnings)
ci-bot: build #4721: unit tests passed (3,214 tests)
ci-bot: build #4721: integration tests FAILED -> failing suite: payments.integration (1/23)
ci-bot: failure snippet: "ERROR: api-schema mismatch - expected field 'user_id' but got 'id' in /v1/payments/create" (logs: https://ci.internal/4721/logs)
miguel: oh, looks like a contract/migration mismatch. new client shape?
anya: which PR introduced the client change?
kevin: that was PR #880 (client: normalize id->user_id). I noted it in the SDK changelog but maybe the server rollout didn't coordinate.
deploybot: Canary deploy paused: build #4721 failed integration checks. Auto-rollback not triggered because previous canary already healthy. Manual decision required: rollback to release/v1.13.9 or pause and hotfix?
olivia: prefer pause + hotfix so we don't roll back unrelated changes in other services.
sara: propose: create branch release/v1.14.0-hotfix from main, revert PR #880 client change, run quick e2e and then resume canary.
miguel: +1. I'll open the hotfix branch and assign @kevin to revert the client change.
kevin: on it. reverting client change now, will push commit and trigger hotfix build (tag: hotfix-revert-client-880).
ci-bot: build #4722 triggered (hotfix-revert-client-880): lint -> unit -> e2e
ci-bot: build #4722: lint passed
ci-bot: build #4722: unit tests passed
ci-bot: build #4722: e2e: flaky step payments.integration -> rerun started
ci-bot: build #4722: e2e passed on rerun. summary: all checks green. artifacts: https://ci.internal/4722/artifacts
deploybot: Canary resume scheduled in 10m using tag release/v1.14.0-hotfix (build #4722).
sara: I'll update release notes and change window: note that client schema revert applied, reapply after coordinated contract rollout. Also pinging support to watch for user-facing errors.
anya: pinging #support now and adding quick-run checklist to the canary run (smoke + payments sanity).
kevin: pushed hotfix branch and tagged. If any further failures, we can rollback to 1.13.9, but for now resuming with hotfix.
sara: thanks everyone — I'll keep this thread updated if canary shows regressions. :thumbsup:
